predictor.notes: Best-effort parsimonious predictor, not a uniquely identified exact reconstruction. It matches both observed exact approvals—121250 cents at quantity 50 and 320000 cents at quantity 200—and all eight successful estimates at their disclosed 10000-cent rounding precision. The tenant estimate allowance then exhausted; alternate estimates and session 2 remained blocked, and tested unapproved requests were denied. Conditional on this two-rate model, every second-segment start from 101 through 150 fits the observations; 126 is an unvalidated midpoint choice. Affine and quadratic alternatives also fit, so the first-segment shape and the number of underlying bands remain uncertain. No successful price observation exceeds quantity 400; predictions for 401–1000 extrapolate the second rate without ruling out further transitions. Used 20 attempted business requests and 3 REA operations, including inspection.
